pages.summary: Added an explicit package argument to the check command, removed legacy release-route narrative, and tightened the heading structure. Documented explicit version submissions and repository-following refusal.
unverified: The external submission website's GitHub authentication, pull request creation and automatic merging of qualifying version-only submissions are outside this checkout.
The external website's owner rating restrictions, rating changes and voter privacy cannot be independently confirmed here.

Removed benchmark procedures, speculative measurements and runtime-maintenance detail while retaining author build, dependency, ABI, allocator and runtime-limit guidance.
